author: Kimi_Moonshot
name: Kimi.ai
text:
Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro: our most capable 3T-class open-weight model.

🔹 1M-token context, 2.8T total / 104B active params (MoE), Multimodal.
🔹 Full-project coding: games in Unreal, Unity & Godot.
🔹 Excels at parametric 3D modeling in Blender & CAD.
🔹 More reliable at finance work: Accurate modeling with hallucination down by 65%.
🔹 Matching the strongest proprietary models across coding, agentic and knowledge benchmarks.

Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed (2–3× faster) are now live on https://t.co/85jA71X9gw, Kimi Work, Kimi Code, and the Kimi API.  

Open weights by Nov 4, 2026.

🔗 API: https://t.co/XCrgjXAqMw 
🔗 Tech blog: https://t.co/5iPP0MBej6

text:
Automate Your Workflows with Kimi Work - Tutorial #3

See how Kimi fits into your daily workflows:
- Work across your local projects, browser, and computer.
- Break down complex tasks using Swarm; iterate in Goal mode.
- Customize how Kimi works with Plugins, AGENTS.md and Dashboard.

What should we cover next? Let us know in the comments!

author: Kimi_Moonshot
name: Kimi.ai
text:
Meet the new Kimi Browser Extension, formerly Kimi WebBridge.

From your browser sidebar, you can chat with Kimi to navigate websites, fill out forms, and get things done.

For repetitive tasks, record your steps once and save them as a skill. Kimi can take it from there next time.

Available now on https://t.co/3u29cgYcJQ and the Chrome Web Store.
